title: Complete GOST lifecycle coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix GOST binary discovery, command generation, process lifecycle, cleanup, and constrained-host behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: GOST command generation includes the resolved binary and correct TCP/UDP/local/remote options
Missing/unexecutable binary and permission errors are actionable and never yield false running state
Start/stop/restart/reconnect/cleanup tests cover both child and systemd paths
The process does not leave orphan listeners or consume unbounded resources on failure

steps.details: Extend the optimization harness with binary discovery, command shape, missing binary, process exit, and cleanup fixtures.
Read `config/gost.ts`, `binary.ts`, process/runner modules, and existing tests; identify only verified gaps.
Fix binary/path/argument or lifecycle behavior required by the failing tests without changing supported GOST semantics.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real binary/VPS test evidence separately.

technicalNotes: Keep architecture-specific binary selection explicit and do not include machine-local `tunnels/bin` in the release artifact without a controlled download manifest.
